summary: OpenAI announced Project Camellia, a new datacenter development in Effingham County, Georgia, contracting with Georgia Power for 3.2 gigawatts of power delivered in phases between 2028 and 2032, alongside community benefit and tax commitments.

mechanisms.reason: The document discloses a large multi-gigawatt power contract tied to a new datacenter build, directly signaling rising power demand.
mechanisms.quote: we are contracting with Georgia Power Company for 3.2 gigawatts of power which will be delivered in phases between 2028 and 2032.

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI states it will fund the full infrastructure and electric-service costs of a long-term datacenter project, an explicit capital commitment.
mechanisms.quote: OpenAI will pay the full cost of the infrastructure and electric-service costs required to serve it.

notable_reason: Disclosure of a new 3.2 GW datacenter power contract is a concrete, large-scale infrastructure commitment relevant to power and compute buildout trackers.
